candidates.name: Learned-edge scaffold followed by symbolic internal-module extraction

source_facts.facts: KAN2.0 learns one-dimensional edge functions, adds multiplication nodes, and studies module/symbolic extraction in scientific tasks. No purchase-ranking evidence.
Author implementation; CPU examples do not establish population-scale throughput.

Per-edge atom fitting with complexity/fidelity tradeoff; default auto-symbolic threshold zero; default MSE; Adam/LBFGS; activation/input cache can be checkpointed; speed disables symbolic/cache collection.
Fits c*f(a*x+b)+d with a/b grid then c/d linear regression; default grid101, three zooms, N*grid^2 tensor and regularized covariance R2 proxy.

candidates.source_version_limit: Web-inspected mutable master on 2026-10-15; later implementation must pin/recheck author code.

own_adaptation.mechanism: Learn a continuous spline scaffold on earlier mature labels; locally symbolize and export at most two hidden modules, not final prediction.
own_adaptation.inputs: Eight predeclared registry parents with explicit units/normalization/missingness; no impressions, titles, images, order IDs or new data.
own_adaptation.supervision: Fixed query-macro BCE needs a new bounded indexed-weight/sampling adapter; shipped default MSE is not reused silently.
own_adaptation.novelty_boundary: Potentially distinct proposer: continuous learned scaffold then local symbolization. Operators/feature family are not new. Grammar aliases, generic upstream scores and renamed model-guided search are not admissions.

maturity.warmup: One fixed earliest eligible prefix, at most2000 whole queries /440000 rows; no target-based prefix search.
maturity.fit_available_at: All warmup labels, scaler fits, pruning, atom fits and audit decisions mature and complete at a0.
maturity.downstream_rule: All arm training anchors strictly after a0; identical common training population; no supervised backfill.
maturity.selection_rule: Only a separately authorized fresh development reservation; current CLOSED heldouts not reopened.

candidates.counterhypothesis: Strong trees already encode the interaction; benefit may be generic frozen representation or extra search attempts.

candidates.name: LA-NAM posterior interaction selection — negative admission

source_facts.facts: ICML2024 paper, initial preprint2023, Bayesian neural additive models with posterior-based pair selection.
Gaussian posterior parameter MI is -0.5*log(1-Corr^2), not feature-label synergy.

MI implementation uses unsquared Corr; slack squares precision. triu zero fills exclusions, pairs appended without filtering. Detached-unary scalar multipliers get FullLaplace; main learned prior precisions not passed. Pair stage trains again.
Flattens all entries, including zero-filled diagonal/lower triangle, for topk.

candidates.source_version_limit: Web-inspected mutable main on 2026-10-15; exact fixes in future revisions would need independent recheck.
candidates.own_adaptation: No source repair or admitted model proposal now. Only matrix-only contract gates and a conditional lifecycle design are suggested.
candidates.novelty_boundary: Posterior parameter coupling differs from IIFE label synergy but does not prove functional interaction or new feature information. Any repaired selector still needs random-pair/grammar comparisons.

tiny_literal_falsifiers.name: coupling_is_not_interaction
tiny_literal_falsifiers.interpretation: Duplicated unary multipliers compensate; no crossed-input support identifies a pair effect.

candidates.cheapest_falsifier: Matrix-only sign-invariance/PSD/finite-score checks, explicit eligible i<j coordinates, distinct deterministic pairs, identity and near-singular tests. Exact/affine alias and crossed-support gates remain necessary after code fixes.
candidates.maturity: If later repaired and authorized, same fixed warmup/positive-query-user gates and strictly later common B41 population as MB3-01; every posterior/hyperparameter/pair-stage update must be mature and available before downstream anchors.

finite_conditional_lifecycle.lastlayer_cost: O(N*D^2) accumulation, O(D^2) storage, O(D^3) inversion; main-network curvature can cost more.
finite_conditional_lifecycle.feasibility: Unknown; no runtime/performance claim and no native job authorized.

candidates.metric_and_falsification: Current source fails literal admission. A separately repaired future selector must earn fullY NDCG20/Recall20 and user-cluster evidence over fresh B41, random-pair and existing learned-selection/grammar controls; posterior score alone cannot admit it.
candidates.next_step: Keep as negative finding; no fit while implementation contract or alias/support gates fail.
